verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v1: faman shāʾa yātī sh-shaykha nayla r-raghāʾibi wamin sunani l-hādī l-warā wal-gharāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v4: tarā rāḥilā nāʾī l-maḥallahi rājilā mashīḥā biʿawni llāhi qaṭʿa s-sabāsibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v5: kafāhu th-thurayā laylahu biʾanīsihi biʿiṣmahi rabbi l-ʿarshi lāhī n-nawāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v6: tarā qāʿidā yabqā lahu dahshatu n-nawā ʾaḥāṭat bihi l-ʾaqdāru min kulli jānibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v7: taḥḥulu bihi min ribqahi l-ʿazmi ʾuḥkimat yuʿāwinuhā t-taswīfu dūna l-maṭālibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v8: ʾalahfī famā lī lā ʾarā man yadullunī thabātiyā maḥẓūru waḍāqat madhāhibī
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v9: fala sudda lī l-bībānu ʿan khayri wāṣili wasīli mumiddi bil-wasāʾili nāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v10: khalīfti khayri l-khalqi wajhi wirāthati sarāʾiruhu l-ʿulyā sarat ʿan makāsibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v11: ʾathīlu l-mazāyā ḥāʾilu ʾahla rabbinā ḥakīmu bitaqsīmi l-ḥibā wal-mawāhibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v12: famā wāzana l-ʾaqṭābu min ḥīni waznihi balā mithlu badri kāna bayna l-kawākibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v13: tabannā bihi l-mukhtāru khayra bunuwwati yukannā ʾabā l-ʿabbāsi ṣāfī l-mashāribi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v14: yukannā ʾabā l-fayḍi lladhī shāʿa fakhruhu famā ḥarfu ʿaṭfi bil-ʿawāṭifi ṣāḥibī
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v15: famā sh-shayʾu ʾawqā min dhurāhu wiqāyata ʾidhā nḍamma jāni lābisu bil-mathālibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v16: maḥūṭu biḥifẓi llāhi fī kulli ḥālati lahu suwaru l-ʾadhkāri bayna l-katāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v17: bihim ʿajabu l-ʾaṣwāti ḥīna tasājalū tasājula ʾaṭyāri r-riyāḍi l-ʿajāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v18: wahum ghuraru ʾahlu l-ʿulā waḥulāḥilu wasīmāhumu bayna l-jibāhi l-ḥawājibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v19: ṭiwālu ʾakuffi lam yakhib biʾakuffihim fatā ʾammahum qaṣda l-ʿaṭā kas-saḥāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v20: ʾalā rubba ḍayfi muʿtafi mutaʿʿaṭifi naḥāhum wayunsiyihi l-qirā bil-ʾaqāribi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v21: humu l-ʾālu lā ʾālu ṣ-ṣadā bifalatihi wayaḥsibuhu māʾa kamithli s-sawākibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v22: ʾidhā jāʾahu dhā lam yajidhu murādahu wayarjiʿu ṣadyānā ʿadīma l-marāghibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v23: faṭūbā limin hadhā sh-sharīfu malādhuhu huwa l-quṭbu wal-maktūmu ʿālī l-marātibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v24: huwa s-sirru wal-maknūnu min faḍli rabbinā wafāta yaqīna min ʾamānī n-nawāṣibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v25: wakayfa yubārā lā yubārā bidhī l-ʿulā makārimuhu lā tantahī ʿinda ḥāsibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v26: fakam ʾafḥama l-ḥaysūba ḥaṣru bīʾāyihi waradda ʾilayhi l-ʿudhra ʿaddu l-manāqibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v27: wataswīdu rabbī sh-shaykha ḥāza wilayata ʿināyatu rabbī fī r-rijāli r-rawāsibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v28: taʿʿaraḍ lahu ʾadwāʾa jahli qadi ntakhat junūdu r-radā qādat jiyāda l-maṣāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v29: taʿʿafar lahu khaddā tamannā taʿʿafurā biḥḥisi wamaʿnā fī zdiḥāmi l-ʿaṣāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v30: fala tabraḥan dhā ghīrti bimanāhili lidhī l-faḍli qarmī fī nizāʿi l-majādhibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v31: taḥḥaqaq rajāʾa ʿāzimā biliqāʾihi ʿalā ʾayyī ḥāli faltarum bil-māʾāribi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v32: fabāʿid ʾakhī mā dumta ḥayyā wabāqiyā fala yaghruranka d-dahru janba l-maʿāṭibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v33: ʾidhā ḥaddathatka n-nafsu ʾannaka qādiru biʾīlāʾi ʾamri ghayrahu la tujāwibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v34: faman kāna mansūbā ʾilā silki shaykhinā yanal munyata d-dārayni suḥqā liʿātibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v35: faman kāna ḥaqqā fī btighāʾi wasīlati fayakfīhi shaykhu wāsiʿu ʿan nawāʾibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v36: ʿalā quṭbinā l-ʾaʿlā riḍā llāhi dāʾimā jazā llāhu ʿannā quṭbanā dhā l-mawāhibi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v37: ṣalatu wataslīmu ʿalā shāfiʿi l-warā maʿa l-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi ʿayni l-mashāribi
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v2: tadāʿā ilayhi l-ʿīsu ṭāwiyata l-falā tajawub l-mawāmī wahyā taḥta l-ḥabāʾib
verses.faman-sha-a-yati-sh-shaykha-c1-v3: tujādhibu tadaʾaba s-surā ḥaythumā sarā khayālu lahu ʾaʿwānu shawqi wajālibi
